about: The forming-bar refusal names the reason the server gave (fix/forming-refusal-names-its-reason, found by Deepvue): request-other and varip scripts were told they read barstate. Each id's wording (FR-M1..M3), the ids dropped at either latch door (FR-M4..M6) and the fail-closed wording for an unknown id (FR-M7).
